boundary_confirmation_verbatim: eft edge of the mixed-cell zone
cell_shape_instruction_verbatim: we need to tell the model that the long square rectangular cells are endo if it sees those with the perid cells then that is T
confirmed_definition: T is the left edge of the mixed-cell zone on the main root. Mixed zone is included in Periderm length. Left of T is Endoderm under the regional measurement convention.

biological_cues_from_user.mixed_zone: Visible mixture of Endoderm-like and Periderm-like cell shapes.
biological_cues_from_user.Periderm: Earlier user descriptions: shorter, less orderly cell shapes.

scope: These are expert criteria for this imaging assay; not a claim of universal cell identity from shape alone.
current_model_limit: Current model learns pixel category scores from image-mask examples. A natural-language definition alone does not update trained weights. No explicit supervised mixed-zone target or cell-shape detector has been trained in this workflow.
possible_next_teaching_design: Review clear Endoderm, mixed-zone and clear Periderm image examples, then distinguish mixed-zone appearance while keeping it included in Periderm for length reporting. This is a proposed design, not implemented or demonstrated effective.
